name: deck-renderer
body: Deck renderer: assembles the whole-deck reveal.js document — applies theme CSS, reveal.js config (navigationMode passed through from `navigation`), vertical stacks, anchors and notes — over the per-slide documents. Owns internal/render/deck.go (RenderDeck plus renderDeckSlide, themeStylesheet, insertBeforeSectionClose); it is the top-level entry internal/server.Reloader.renderDefault calls. The render tier splits by role: solution.component.renderer executes templates and section instances bottom-up (internal/render/render.go); deck-renderer assembles the resulting deck document (internal/render/deck.go).
